name: github2snipe
description: Sync GitHub Enterprise or organization members to Snipe-IT license seats

config_schema.label: Connection Mode
config_schema.hint: "enterprise" to sync all members of a GitHub Enterprise; "organization" to sync a single org

config_schema.label: GitHub Enterprise Slug
config_schema.hint: Required when mode: enterprise. URL slug from github.com/enterprises/<slug>

config_schema.label: GitHub Organization Name
config_schema.hint: Required when mode: organization. The org's login name (not display name)

config_schema.label: GitHub Personal Access Token
config_schema.hint: enterprise mode: admin:enterprise scope. organization mode: read:org scope

config_schema.label: Snipe-IT API Key
config_schema.hint: Admin → API Keys in your Snipe-IT instance

config_schema.label: Snipe-IT License Name Override
config_schema.hint: Optional. Overrides the auto-resolved name ("GitHub Enterprise" or "GitHub")

config_schema.label: License Name Prefix
config_schema.hint: Optional prefix prepended to the license name, e.g. "Acme - "

config_schema.label: License Name Suffix
config_schema.hint: Optional suffix appended to the license name, e.g. " (acme)"

config_schema.label: Include Pending Invitations
config_schema.hint: Sync pending membership invitations (organization mode only)

config_schema.label: Slack Webhook URL
config_schema.hint: Optional. Incoming webhook for sync notifications
